name: Redbarn Ventures
tagline: We design, market, advise and invest.
description: Redbarn Ventures is a studio and holding company that designs, markets, advises and invests. One small senior team, from first logo to the boardroom.

approach.title: Decide
approach.text: We start with the decision that matters: who it is for, what it has to do and what we will not do. One page, agreed before anything is made.

approach.title: Build
approach.text: A small senior team makes the work itself - identity, product, site, deck or plan - in short cycles you can see and steer.

approach.title: Compound
approach.text: We stay on to market, measure and improve. Good work is kept, extended and reused, so every round starts further ahead.
